questions.why: In the correct series each term adds 5, so 71 should be 66. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a row of 43 students, Ajay is 6th from the left and Lata is 24th from the right. How many students sit between them?
Statement: "The company's profits have increased since the new advertising campaign." Which judgment is sound?
opts: The rise is solely due to the campaign
The rise is unrelated to the campaign
The campaign may have contributed to the rise
questions.why: Timing alone shows a possible link, not sole cause. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.

Statements: Some doctors are teachers. No teachers are singers. Conclusions: I. Some singers are not doctors. II. Some doctors are not singers.

questions.q: The present ages of Sunil and Deepak are in the ratio 4 : 3. After 7 years the ratio will be 31 : 25. What is Deepak's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 4k and 3k: (4k + 7)/(3k + 7) = 31/25 gives k = 6, so Deepak is 18. GPSC-style practice item.
